name: Excommunication
description:
Any [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')|U] person placed under Excommunication by the [GetCountry('PAP').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] is cut from the structure of the Church and barred from receiving the sacraments.

This will [excommunicate|e] the [ruler|e] of the target country.

name: Apostolicae Servitutis
description:
In spite of many prohibitive laws of the Church, some ecclesiastics had drifted into the habit of occupying themselves with worldly business and pursuits.

This is outrageous and should stop.

name: Benedictus Deus
description: Maintaining the cohesion and harmony of the Catholic Faith is the most important duty of all members of our faith.

name: Call for Crusade
description: His Holiness the Pope has once again called for the faithful to march against the enemies of Christ. We must once again come together and bleed for the Church and the Holy See in this new crusade. Deus Vult!

name: Christiana Pietas
description: As good Christians we must lead by example. We shall invite the Jews and other unbelievers to our lands so that they may see the grace of Christian rule and accept the Lord into their hearts.

name: Dei Gratia Rex
description: In their hearts, all the faithful know that God ultimately selected our ruler, and thus they rule by His Grace and by His Word.

name: Enact Law
description: Choose a [policy|e] for a new [law|e] in an [international_organization|e]

name: Imperial Election
description: The [hre_emperor|e] of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] is chosen based on the votes of the [electors|e]. [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').Custom('GetHREElectionDescription')]

name: Illius Qui Se Pro Divini
description: The soldiers of Christ must once again spill their blood upon the shores of the Holy Land. The spirit of the Crusades must be revived, for God wills it!

name: Immensa Aeterni Dei
description: Reorganize the Roman Curia, establishing permanent congregations of cardinals to advise the Pope on various subjects.

name: In Coena Domini
description: All faithful should condemn and report any acts of piracy, as it is a betrayal of the Lords Grace.

name: Inter Gravissimas
description: A reform of the bureaucracy is an important exercise for the faithful, to maintain their proper worship.

name: Libertas Ecclesiae
description:
$libertas_ecclesiae$ is the notion of freedom of ecclesiastical authority from secular or the temporal power, which guided the Reform movement which began in the 11th century.
But what if a puppet of the Holy Roman Emperor is sitting on the Throne of Saint Peter?

name: Swiss Election
description: The members of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('swiss_confederation').GetName] shall participate in a direct vote to elect the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('swiss_confederation').GetLeaderTitle], who shall represent the Confederation on the public stage.
